governing_outcome: Every durable read/create/update/delete/output/migration action must be classified against one persistent-asset model before it can influence authority or execution, so GitHub/Library/Notion/Drive/chat/Memory/Custom Instructions/automations cannot silently become competing current control planes after migration.
raw_evidence: Financial Writing migrated to GitHub but Library still contained an ACTIVE_POINTER with retired topology references until this audit.
Google Drive legacy continuity documents were already inside a legacy archive folder but retained current-looking Router/State/System Policy/Handoff names and remained globally searchable.
Notion retained an old CURRENT_CHAT_HANDOFF, PENDING_REVIEWQUEUE and migrated writing regression records alongside reusable ArticleBase/IndustryBase knowledge.

UAOS RETRIEVAL_POLICY governs repository retrieval and AUTHORITY_WRITE_POLICY governs authority scope/mutation, but production had no common cross-surface asset lifecycle/CRUD/output classification model.

During this audit the acting controller twice omitted or mis-sequenced a branch target before a GitHub write; the production write was immediately reverted and later nonexistent-branch writes failed. These incidents are direct evidence that model intention plus prose policy is insufficient mutation admission.
professional_method_evidence: Accellera UVM register abstraction supports multiple physical access paths behind one abstract model and warns that mirrors become stale when changes occur outside observed paths.
UVM explicit prediction uses monitors/predictors to observe operations from all access paths rather than trusting only model-originated writes.

Selected analogy: persistent-surface governance requires one abstract asset model, per-surface adapters, observed side effects, and a scoreboard/reconciliation step; a search hit or stale mirror is not authority.

architecture_candidates.reason: Leaves each connector/surface to rely on naming conventions and human memory; already disproven by residual active-looking assets.
Would clean one domain but preserve the common failure class for every other Agent and future migration.
Creates more shadow authorities and drift.
Adds one common lifecycle/CRUD/output contract while domains retain ownership of business assets and declare only domain-specific surface usage.

acceptance_criteria: Every persistent asset class has owner, authority role, lifecycle state, allowed operations and migration/retirement semantics.
Non-authority surfaces cannot be promoted to current business authority by search presence, memory relevance or stale bootstrap text.
Material persistent writes require a declared target surface and asset role before execution.
Migrations require verify-target then retire-source; retired sources remain non-authoritative even if still searchable.
Outputs/deliverables are typed separately from state/authority.
Financial declares GitHub as current business authority and classifies Notion/Drive/Library/chat/Memory/Custom Instructions/automations without duplicating parent policy.
Current cleanup removes or clearly retires misleading Financial control-plane pointers while preserving useful historical/knowledge evidence.
known_boundary: Native ChatGPT cannot physically intercept every product-internal chat, memory or Custom Instructions operation through repository code. The common policy is mechanically enforceable in UAOS-controlled paths and behaviorally binding in native ChatGPT; external-surface cleanup is verified through available connectors.
